title: Bulk person delete call path (API/Celery/Dagster → bulk_delete.py)
answers: How does bulk person deletion work?
Where is person deletion queued via Celery?
body:
- API: posthog/api/person.py bulk delete action (max 1000 ids/distinct_ids). If settings.PERSON_BULK_DELETE_ASYNC → `_queue_bulk_delete_persons` → posthog/tasks/delete_persons.py:queue_person_deletion (Celery chunks of PERSONS_PER_DELETION_TASK=100) → `process_queued_person_deletion`.
- Sync path: `resolve_persons_for_deletion` → `delete_persons_profile` → `queue_person_event_deletion` + `queue_person_recording_deletion`.
- Dagster posthog/dags/data_deletion_requests.py:delete_person_profiles_op also calls `delete_persons_profile(actor=None)`.
- posthog/models/person/bulk_delete.py: `_tombstone_and_delete_persons` order: `delete_person` per person (CH tombstone, step TOMBSTONE_CLICKHOUSE) → `delete_persons_from_postgres` once (DELETE_POSTGRES; failure drops all from deleted list) → `bulk_log_activity` last (skips persons already logged, so retries don't duplicate).
- Queued path: `_paginated_get_distinct_ids_for_person` (5000/page), `_run_queued_deletion_steps` batches ≤ QUEUED_DELETION_DISTINCT_IDS_PER_BATCH (20000); order training → recording → profile delete; profile delete last because it removes distinct ids retries need. Failed persons are skipped by later steps.
- Celery retries only failed persons, MAX_DELETION_RETRIES=3, then raises `PersonDeletionIncomplete`.
- `queue_person_event_deletion` bulk-creates AsyncDeletion(DeletionType.Person); recording deletion starts Temporal `delete-recordings-with-person` via `_start_recording_workflows` (`_chunk_persons`: 100 persons/2000 distinct ids).
